title: On $U(1)^{n-2}$-Invariant Special Lagrangian $n$-Folds
summary: This paper develops a construction of families of $ U(1)^{n-2} $-invariant special Lagrangian $ n $-folds in $ \mathbb{C}^{n} $, extending the analytic framework introduced by Joyce ($ n = 3 $) to arbitrary dimension. By reducing the special Lagrangian condition to a quasilinear elliptic system of two-dimensional non-linear Cauchy-Riemann equations, we analyse both the resulting geometry and its degenerations at singular points.
